global → global identity move is not guarded in moveInsight(). The lock + atomic write sequence is safe (source and target paths are identical, so the target write overwrites the same file the source read came from — the net effect is the insight appears twice in the file until the source splice runs, but since both writes are under a single lock span this is not observable externally). However the behavior is semantically odd (insight gets a new ID, old entry removed — effectively a re-ID). Worth a future hardening ticket consistent with the repository identity-move guard. Out of WP-003 scope.
